name: CX Technology Corporation
summary: Established in 1972 in Taipei, Taiwan, CX Technology Corporation is an international manufacturer known for its expertise in cold and warm forging, stamping, and plastic injection components. The company, which was formerly known as ChainXen Metal Factory Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in May 2000, produces a wide array of products. These include a variety of metal and plastic parts for speakers, such as cones, dust caps, front and back plates, copper caps, grilles, shell pots, motor structure assemblies, and both plastic injection and steel baskets. For the automotive sector, they supply items like inner collars, spool housings, brake pistons, pulley shafts, and brackets for speakers and head units. CX Technology also offers integrated cable routing solutions and a range of other cold-forged components. Complementing its manufacturing capabilities, the company provides a comprehensive suite of services, including metal forming, plastic injection molding, CNC machining, surface treatments, sub-assembly, and outsourcing support.
